lunch.name: Croque Monsieur (Ham and Cheese Sandwich)
lunch.description: Classic French lunch - toasted ham and cheese sandwich with mustard and béchamel. Adding egg makes it Croque Madame
instructions: Butter outside of bread slices
On unbuttered side of 2 slices, spread thin layer of Dijon mustard and béchamel
Layer ham and cheese on each
Top with second bread slice, buttered side out
Heat skillet over medium heat
Cook sandwich 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy on both sides
Press gently with spatula - cheese should melt completely
Serve hot with cornichons and mustard
lunch.notes: Medium heat prevents burning outside before cheese melts. Pressing helps cheese distribution
lunch.fun_fact: Croque Monsieur is classic French lunch, adding egg makes it Croque Madame (Mrs. instead of Mr.)
alternatives: Add fried egg to make Croque Madame

lunch.name: Salade Niçoise (French Tuna Salad)
lunch.description: Traditional lunch from Nice - fresh salad with tuna, eggs, vegetables and anchovies. Uses local fresh ingredients
instructions: Arrange lettuce on large plate
Arrange potatoes, beans, tomatoes and olives in sections
Top with tuna chunks and egg wedges
Whisk olive oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper for dressing
Drizzle dressing over salad
Top with anchovy fillets
Serve immediately at room temperature
lunch.notes: Traditional recipe calls for raw tuna, but cooked canned tuna is acceptable substitute
lunch.fun_fact: Salade Niçoise is traditional lunch from Nice, uses fresh local ingredients of Provence
alternatives: Use fresh tuna instead of canned

lunch.name: Ratatouille (French Vegetable Stew)
lunch.description: Provençal vegetable stew from French countryside. Becomes more flavorful after sitting overnight
instructions: Heat olive oil, sauté onion and garlic until soft
Add eggplant and cook 10 minutes, stirring occasionally
Add zucchini, peppers, tomatoes, thyme and bay leaf
Cook over medium heat 20-30 minutes, stirring occasionally
Vegetables should be tender but not mushy
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with fresh basil
Serve warm or at room temperature with crusty bread
lunch.notes: Ratatouille improves overnight as flavors meld. Can be made ahead and reheated
lunch.fun_fact: Ratatouille is Provençal vegetable dish from French countryside, becomes more flavorful after sitting overnight
alternatives: Top with grilled bread and cheese
